title: Editor crash when closing all tabs
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in d7c45b19ccf6ddadc73d1c8423cd2848f59de437
Not reproducible in 4.7-stable 5b4e0cb

I'm bisecting right now

### System information

### Issue description

Editor crashes when closing all tabs in specific situations when the first tab in history is in focus.

The problem is in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d7c45b19ccf6ddadc73d1c8423cd2848f59de437/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp#L3632

which indexes `history` with `history_pos` equal to -1

Here is the debug print I added.
```
void ScriptEditor::_roll_back_to_pre_tab() {
	print_line("roll_back: history size=" + itos(history.size()) + " history_pos=" + itos(history_pos));

	Control *tselected = tab_container->get_current_tab_control();
	if (history[history_pos].control != tselected) {
		return;
	}
```

I have a fix that works by checking if the history_pos is valid at the start of the function. I will make a PR after I bisect.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Open godot, while making sure there are no scripts/documentation pages open. If there were, close them and restart godot.
3. Open 2 documentation pages using F1 and search. I will refer to these as page A and page B.
4. After creating them page B is in focus on screen. Click the back button. Now A is in focus.
5. Right click on A and click "Close all".
